units.source_text: “不过，比起近处来，一千多米以外的地方反而落下了许多火灰。

en.t: But compared with nearby places, much more ash actually fell over a thousand meters away.

units.source_text: 公司那伙人尽力做了许多防备，这房子才不至于被烧掉。

en.t: The people from the company did everything they could to take precautions, and that was why this house did not burn down.
I, for my part, thought it might have been just as well if it had burned down.

units.source_text: 因为烧掉了，说不定反而有机会搬到海边别墅区去。

en.t: Because if it had burned down, we might even have had a chance to move to the seaside villa district.

units.source_text: 我早就想过，父亲过世了，还要什么工厂呢。”

en.t: I had long thought that, with Father gone, what need did we still have for a factory?
